label: kizuna_math_b_03
text: Please forgive me if this is an...odd question.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: kizuna_math_b_04
text: Were you perhaps watching me from afar\njust now?[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: kizuna_math_b_05
text: Y-yes, I suppose you wouldn’t have been doing\nsomething like that. I’m sorry.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: kizuna_math_b_06
text: You see... Oh, how should I put this?[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: kizuna_math_b_07
text: Recently, there have been times when I feel as if\nI am being watched...[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: kizuna_math_b_08
text: Not by a Pokémon, mind you, but by a person.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: kizuna_math_b_09
text: I thought it might be a ghost, so I tried asking my\nsister for help. She said it most likely isn’t one.\r\nShe’s good with Ghost-type Pokémon, you know.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: kizuna_math_b_10
text: Perhaps one of my students is quietly watching\nme, waiting for a chance to ask me a question?[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: kizuna_math_b_11
text: Goodness, if that wasn’t an intense gaze I felt!\nIf you notice someone with a sort of fire in their\r\neyes, come tell me, won’t you?[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: kizuna_math_b_12
text: If they are too shy to come ask me themselves,\nthen I’ll go to them![VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: kizuna_math_b_system_01
text: You became even closer with Ms. Tyme!
